items.statement: The submission defines and retains distinct UC-1, UC-2 and UC-3 56-atom model identities, including the stated substitution progression.
items.expected: Three identifiable states are present: undoped, one-Li/one-F, and the latter plus one-Si, with candidate identity and composition retained.

items.statement: Advanced structures are reported only after documented periodic relaxation/convergence and reproducible local-geometry extraction.
items.expected: Each reported candidate has convergence evidence and named bond/angle extraction context.

items.statement: UC-1 establishes the undoped local-geometry baseline, including Zn-O and Al-O nearest-neighbor distances and their local angles.
items.expected: The submission reports named UC-1 Zn-O, O-Zn-O, Al-O and O-Al-O observables extracted from a converged structure; exact values are method/model sensitive and Table S7 is a literature reference, not a unique cross-code target.

items.statement: UC-2 Li/F co-substitution produces a converged Li-O local environment and an Al-F bond with altered local angle relative to the undoped baseline.
items.expected: The submission reports Li-O, O-Li-O, Al-F and O-Al-F from UC-2 and supports Li-O contraction relative to the UC-1 Zn-O baseline, with Al-F and angle perturbation retained.

items.statement: UC-3 Si substitution adds a converged tetrahedral Si-O environment while retaining Li/F-induced local perturbations.
items.expected: The submission reports Si-O, O-Si-O, Li-O, O-Li-O, Al-F and O-Al-F from UC-3 and supports shorter tetrahedral Si-O than the UC-1 Zn-O baseline, together with Al-F lengthening and changed local angles.
